Module aeonics.core
Package aeonics.util

Interface Documented

  • All Superinterfaces:
    Exportable
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    Action.Template, Channel, Destination.Template, Endpoint.Template, Origin.Template, Parameter, Relationship, Template
    public interface Documented
extends Exportable
    Provides basic documentation about a class instance so that it can be exposed to the end user. Documented classes must also be Exportable to provide a representation of the instance to the user.
